collection.title: Ford Mondeo Saloon 2007 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Mondeo Saloon 2007 - 2014 version uses a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 19" for the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
